sentences.text: In the 1990s, the federal government announced a new Federal Policy on Aging as part of a Seniors Strategy to develop a comprehensive agenda for action on issues of importance to seniors and an aging society.

By 2000, the Division of Aging and Seniors within Health Canada served as a centre of expertise and focal point for information on aging, working to prepare Canadian society for the aging of the population by providing national leadership and consulting with partners across federal departments, provinces, territories, and research and seniors' organizations.
